decisions.reason: Its award-backed launch, close fit with the established yogurt range, and continued survival suggest performance at or above aspiration levels, so we would keep it.
As a near-adjacent cheese product in a growing market, its continued presence indicates acceptable results and does not yet justify reallocating resources away from it.

Because this multi-variant spicy cheese line uses more shelf and coordination resources, it faces some rationalisation risk, but absent clear evidence of falling short of aspirations we would keep it.
This mild soft-cheese extension appears to have earned a place in the portfolio after several years, so despite some overlap risk in the cheese range it would still be kept.
